correctness.rationale: The proof works for every real no-tie homogeneous hyperplane. Oddness of its sign kills same-parity Walsh blocks; the smaller parity space has degree <=L-1. Multiplication by the defining linear form takes that smaller space into the larger opposite parity space, and its quadratic pairing with the compressed sign equals E[|ell| |g|^2]>=m||g||^2. Since ||ell*g||<=M||g||, the cross-parity map has least singular value >=m/M and full rank. Singular-value pairing and the exact binomial alternating sum yield the claimed multiplicity, counts and gap. n=1,L=0,L=n, zero coefficients and complex-valued g are covered. The 443 small parameter checks use exact integer arithmetic and modular rank, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The spatial domain is the natural family of all homogeneous linear halfspaces and the frequencies are canonical Walsh low-pass bands. Exact half-energy multiplicity is an invariant across arbitrarily tilted real hyperplanes despite varying noncentral spectra; the lower gap resolves a natural robustness question and makes the transition rigid under positive geometric margin. This is an all-dimensions structural classification and not a sampled numerical table, renaming, trivial degree substitution, or routine parameter increment.
